title: Make 30 Eligible Debit Card Purchases of Minimum $3 Online or in-Store, Get $50 Cashback @ St. George
body:
Deal: Make 30 Eligible Debit Card Purchases of Minimum $3 Online or in-Store, Get $50 Cashback @ St. George

[JAF] I got email for BANKSA as well. I think they’re doing it for the whole Westpac group. 30 transactions is huge though idk easiest way to do it
[mrvaluepack] Buy 30 of these 1 at a time. Sorted.
https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/6057659/wo…
[discountdiva] Nah doesn't have to be 1 at a time, just do your usual woolies shop and split to $3 payments
[Click_It] I’m just picturing a full Woolies checkout queue while you ask the 15 year old cashier to split $90 into 30 separate $3 payments, and the reaction of the 15 people behind you 😃
[discountdiva] @Click_It: Uhh, I just use self check out?
[Click_It] @discountdiva: Shhh, don’t ruin my imaginary checkout disaster with facts. 😃
I'll see myself out…
[ptsordos] I got the offer too, but it only needs 15 transactions. I guess the number of transactions may vary.
[discountdiva] Last time I got this from Westpac, I used it to purchase $5 gift cards from SB. Easy $50 for me
[OnlyHans] Post Billpay for me - unfortunately only $30 then.
But at approximately 15 seconds per transaction it was still equivalent to $240 per hour tax-free.
[Click_It] It's no fun to neg when asked to neg, so I've upvoted you instead. Take that!
[crackman] Did this last time with st George. Sadly not targetted this time
[jiayijames] Westpac could be targeting accounts that are open, but rarely / never in use.
[timhn] Got nothing. Guess because my balance in the account is $0 ?
[discountdiva] Mine also had $0 balance. I only opened it for the $50 bonus and SB deals
[mkowarkski] Probably need to buy something cheap online at Amazon or Kmart and buy multiple ones to reach this goal! (free delivery with prime or one pass)
[discountdiva] You can just buy Amazon gift cards or split payment at woolies/coles/kmart etc
[Piggy29] Can I purchase $3 gift cards on Amazon for multiple times?
[ozoner] Just a hint, if you part pay by card at Woolworths self serve checkouts, every part payment counts as an individual transaction towards your 15/30 transaction requirement.
Source : used this for about 20 of my 30 transactions when St George ran the same deal in May or June. Worked fine.
